column1: # The registry of the host of the machine: kind, Russian, English (task 149, format 2.14, AL-46). Not a dictionary of names: a name that a file declares gets its JSON name from the brackets of its declaration.

# machine: the names of the nested machines of the registry of the caller (the party of the kind `machine` and the parameter `вложенные` of the fragment Pause name the machine by the name of the registry).
# field: the fields of the built-in records of the language (`запись_перехода.код`, the record `СобытиеЖурнала` of spec section 2).

# signal, signal_field: the signals of the call protocol that the fragment Pause reads (its common events) and their fields; the fragment declares no file of its own that would give them JSON names (spec section 9, AL-35).
